conditions.world_generation: Structure and bridge changes apply only to newly generated chunks

conditions.release_state: Gameplay fixes remain in testing until player acceptance

change.summary: Stabilize Major Update 4 client state, quests, rewards, hosted bosses, handbook, JEI and structure ownership

modifiers.after: immediate defeat, participant removal and arena release
all exact registered structural bosses use the shared arena lifecycle

modifiers.before: manual raid could be created without an event
modifiers.after: an active matching Boss Raid event is required
clipped bounds-fitted preview with short find, fight, immunity and drop pages
top-level Ores category owns tagged ore and material families

modifiers.before: RoadWeaver could place a bridge through Abridged
modifiers.after: skip only the RoadWeaver bridge when a valid Abridged bridge intersects the span plus 20 blocks
StructBlend owns eligible surface blending and excludes exact underground and seabed structures
separate JEM structure IDs use Better Villages vanilla pools inside the merged village set with custom spacing disabled

cause.owner: JEM domain modules, bootstrap, managed pack and exact-version structure adapters

rationale.purpose: Fix the reported production regressions while retaining one authority for each gameplay, UI and world-generation fact
rationale.decision_source: User reports and explicit implementation, MineRENT deployment and later main-promotion request
rationale.implementation_choices: Use narrow exact-version adapters, server authority, registry-backed structural boss identity and separate village IDs instead of replacing native interfaces

introduced.summary: Implement the complete stabilization plan and prepare one client-and-server release

history.summary: Correct client preservation, quest identity and persistence, reward response, hosted encounter lifecycle, handbook, JEI and world-generation ownership
Move removed Weather Glass and Exposure implementation paths from current ownership to historical evidence.
Archived source paths removed with Create, Immersive Aircraft and their retired integrations

relations: Structure Layout Optimizer retains jigsaw performance ownership
Grand Capitals retains the five vanilla village IDs
notes: The AutoModpack state directory remains durable and is not deleted
Better Villages custom spacing is disabled
unresolved: Fresh-chunk visuals, first-login rendering, FTB dedicated GUI and boss handbook presentation require player acceptance after deployment
